policy: AGENTS.md and every markdown file under .pi/skills/orchestrator-worker-reviewer are review-gated: a change is reviewed by deepseek-v4-pro build 0813 first (glm-5.3 only when no provider answers with 0813, with the unavailability stated in fallbackReason), judged against the reason recorded here, which names what changes, why now, and what was rejected. ProtectedAgentDocReviewTests recomputes each sha256 and fails when the text moved after review.

reviews.reason:
changes: (1) SKILL.md + references/models.md — the acceptance seat is corrected from "model-independent of
worker AND reviewer" to model-independent of the WORKER, shared with the reviewer by design. The false claim
appeared in SIX places, all now corrected: SKILL.md §acceptance prose, SKILL.md role-table Acceptance row,
SKILL.md default-item 4, models.md role-table Acceptance row, models.md default-item 4, and models.md
"Acceptance (step 5)" prose. The first review pass found the third of those still standing
(SKILL.md:367) and the count in this reason wrong at four; both are fixed in this revision.
(2) The UI tester pin moves to ollama-cloud/minimax-m3.1-flash (fastrouter fallback), superseding
ollama-cloud/beam (owner 2026-10-19) and ollama/minimax-m3:cloud. (3) AGENTS.md — a new "Governing documents
are review-gated" section naming the reviewer order, the record file, the guard test, and the limit of the
mechanism.

why: the acceptance claim is read at seat-selection time and would have put a fourth model into every round
to protect a property that does not matter; the UI tester pin named a model on a provider whose row does not
answer and a clinepass id that does not exist, so a dispatched UI test would have failed at the provider.
Both were corrected the same night the agent edited this skill mid-round with no review at all — twice — while
also making two confident factual claims about the repo that a stronger reader disproved in minutes. The gate
exists to stop that class: a governing document is what the next agent obeys before it reads any code. It
worked on its first use, on this very diff.

rejected: protecting only SKILL.md (references/models.md carries every model pin and the tier ladder, and held
two stale copies of the very claim being fixed here); Q64(a)'s literal two-review sequence in favour of one
review of the final text plus the guard that enforces it; a commit-trailer attestation (survives squash-merge,
is written by the same agent that wrote the change, and needs history a shallow clone lacks); flagging @_error
renders instead of the exception source (defeated by renaming the field).

registry evidence (verified by the supervisor against `pi --list-models`, 2026-10-27): `ollama-cloud` lists
`minimax-m3.1-flash`; `fastrouter` lists `minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash`; `clinepass` lists only
`cline-pass/minimax-m3`, so the fallback changes provider rather than pinning an id that does not exist there.

known-stale, deliberately not changed: references/models.md:184-187 quotes past round-doc traceability headers
that recorded `minimax-m3` at the time; rewriting them would falsify the record of those rounds.
reviews.attestation: Reviewed the six-site acceptance-seat correction, the minimax-m3.1-flash UI-tester pin, and the AGENTS.md review-gate section against the stated reason; all agree, no retracted claim survives.
